statement: My teaching and mentoring connect mechanical design, intelligent control, and clinical needs. I encourage students to turn rehabilitation challenges into testable engineering questions and working robotic prototypes.

activities.title: Undergraduate Thesis Supervision
activities.description: Supervised ten undergraduate students in completing graduation theses and design projects; four were recognized as university-level outstanding theses.

activities.title: Reconfigurable Upper-Limb Rehabilitation Robot
activities.description: Guided an undergraduate team in developing a reconfigurable, multi-configuration upper-limb rehabilitation robot.

activities.title: Spinal Assist Exoskeleton
activities.description: Guided a student team in developing a spinal assist exoskeleton with a focus on variable stiffness and wearable compatibility.
